responsibility: Implements the main induction-variable optimization pass for tree SSA loops. For each loop it discovers interesting IV uses and candidate IVs, computes machine- and profile-aware costs for generic, address, and compare uses (including target doloop support), selects an optimal candidate set balancing rewrite cost and register pressure, creates the new IVs, rewrites uses and exit/control expressions to them, and removes obsolete IV computations while resetting SCEV and trip-count caches invalidated by the rewrite.
same_name_distinction: Implements the ivopts pass itself: it analyzes loop IV uses and candidates, performs target-aware costing, selects an IV set, rewrites loops, and handles doloop-specific optimization decisions. Unlike gcc/tree-ssa-loop-ivopts.h, this is the executable optimization implementation rather than the exported declarations and helper prototypes.
